contact.basis: Dry Esplanade pavement immediately west of the convex pavilion entrance, clear of deck/roof/water and north/south shop wings.

verticalDatum: Native Welsh Government LiDAR metre heights; TIFF declares EPSG:27700 horizontally but no explicit vertical CRS. Dry-ground relative placement, no assumed absolute datum conversion.

sources.method: Lossless native Float32 crop; original cells and no-data values retained.
Lossless native Float32 crop; original cells and no-data values retained.

attribution: Welsh Government; LiDAR2020–2023, Open Government Licence
method: Unmodified native1m Float32 DTM cells, bilinearly sampled in EPSG:27700 with PROJ OSTN15 transform. Review grid65-square6m; no height fitting, flattening, seabed carving, water filling or no-data replacement.
limitations: One metre pixel spacing is not surveyed vertical accuracy. Ground beneath roofs/deck can be filtered/interpolated.
Survey2022-04-01 recorded intertidal terrain around pier; water elevation, true bathymetry and pile embedment not established.
Host placement samples its own ground at the dry entrance reference; other host elevation datasets may differ.
